gaps.detail: Neither of the two strong candidates (adni-go2-plasma-lipidomics, adni-go2-serum-metabolomics-mxp500) has explicit commercial-use clearance documented in the wiki. ADNI operates under LONI DUA and AMP-AD governance; commercial terms must be verified directly before project commitment.

All AD plasma metabolomics cohorts in the wiki use targeted platforms (Baker Institute LC-MS/MS, Biocrates MXP500, Biocrates p180, GC-FID). If the buyer requires broad untargeted metabolomics (covering TCA intermediates, organic acids, amino acids beyond lipids), no cohort in the current wiki satisfies the scope. Buyer should clarify targeted vs. untargeted requirement.

The strongest new candidate from the 219-entity wiki (adni-go2-serum-metabolomics-mxp500, depth=0.62) uses serum not plasma. Serum and plasma are non-interchangeable for many metabolomics applications. If serum is acceptable to the buyer, the effective candidate pool doubles.

Only adni-go2-plasma-lipidomics and adni-go2-serum-metabolomics-mxp500 formally document and model statin confounding. All other candidates (aspree, lleida) are silent on statin use — a direct mismatch with buyer's explicit hard negative.

Three cohorts use the Biocrates platform (adni-go2-serum-metabolomics-mxp500 uses MXP500; adni1-serum-metabolomics-biocrates-p180 and blsa use p180; ages-reykjavik uses p180). Cross-cohort aggregation on the p180 metabolite intersection set is feasible but serum-only. Two cohorts use Baker Institute LC-MS/MS (adni-go2-plasma-lipidomics and aspree-dementia-casecohort-lipidomics) — these ARE plasma and ARE cross-cohort harmonised (NIST SRM 1950 protocol documented). Aggregating these two plasma lipidomics datasets is the highest-confidence multi-site option currently in the wiki.

The 219-entity wiki is heavily enriched for ADNI-lineage cohorts (>10 ADNI sub-cohorts). Independent longitudinal plasma metabolomics studies in AD outside the ADNI ecosystem are underrepresented. AIBL (Australian Imaging, Biomarker & Lifestyle study), PREVENT-AD, and PREVENT-Dementia cohorts are not yet in the wiki and could fill this gap.

verdict_reason: Two strong candidates (adni-go2-plasma-lipidomics at depth 0.48, adni-go2-serum-metabolomics-mxp500 at depth 0.62) plus one partial (aspree) and one weak (lleida) survive hard filters; the serum MXP500 cohort is new to this run and significantly deepens the metabolomics coverage beyond lipidomics, but commercial-use terms remain unverified for all candidates and serum vs. plasma matrix compatibility requires buyer confirmation.
